title: Going on, and what Kumo knows
summary: Going on joins Kumo's things in motion with its project and goal pages: Northwind is a matter; the spare room is one thread with its project page, which names it, with its steps; Spring 10k is a goal page alone. Tapping Kumo on the Desk opens what Kumo knows about you: the Portrait and How to help you, short, your tastes from the topic pages, each naming its page, and Getting to know you.

pages.title: Spring 10k

pages.markdown: The Riverside 10K on 14 March, under 50 minutes. Three runs a week.

pages.title: Portrait
pages.markdown: You plan in bursts, then want it all to just happen. You run to think and cook to unwind, and you'd take one long dinner over three quick drinks.

pages.title: How to help you
pages.markdown:
## Talking

Short and straight. Reasons when you ask.

## Mail

Drafts only: you press send.

pages.title: Food
pages.gist: Figs, and spicy but not hot
pages.markdown: You love figs. Spicy, never hot.

pages.title: Travel
pages.markdown: Always a window seat. Long walks in a new city.
